# PendingToolCallApprovalStatus

Where a tool call waiting for approval has got to.

**Kind:** a string enum, used in responses.

## Values

| Value | Description |
|---|---|
| `"Pending"` | Waiting for a person to approve or reject it. |
| `"Approved"` | Approved: the call runs. |
| `"Rejected"` | Rejected: the call does not run, and the agent is told why. |

New values can appear, so treat one you don't know as "something else", not as an error.

## Where it's used

- Inside [`PendingToolCallApproval`](pending-tool-call-approval.md)
